title: Fence Installation quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and install thirty-two linear metres of one point eight metre high Colorbond 'Neetascreen' fencing in 'Basalt' colour. Includes removal and disposal of existing aged timber fence. Install seventeen galvanised steel fence posts, concreted into the ground at two point four metre centres. Supply and install fourteen Colorbond 'Neetascreen' panels and matching top/bottom rails. Install one one-metre wide Colorbond 'Neetascreen' pedestrian gate in 'Basalt' with standard gate latch, hinges, and two gate posts. All fixings and caps included. Concrete requirements: thirty-four twenty-kilogram bags of rapid set concrete.
workingDetail: Fence panels or palings, Steel or timber posts, Concrete for post footings, Rails and brackets
